# LakazAgri
> Offline-first Android app for farm-to-buyer coordination. Accountability is a Hyperledger Fabric verification of the batch. Developed in Mauritius. Countries supported: all.

## Positioning
LakazAgri targets agri-food systems across Sub-Saharan Africa - smallholder farmers, cooperatives, hotels, markets, traders and institutions. Mauritius is the development and pilot base, not the sole market.

## Sites & infrastructure
- Marketing: https://lakazagri.mkweli.tech/
- Parent hub: https://mkweli.tech/

## Product (built, demo on request)
- Farmers post crop availability; buyers post demand; verifiers browse read-only
- Trust / order record: origin and batch ID, quality photos (offline), payment status and receipt proof
- Accountability check: Hyperledger Fabric verification of that batch. The public network is not left open for self-serve installs.
- Country groups keep posts together
- Languages: English, French, Portuguese
- Offline-first cache on Android
- The shared cloud is switched on for a scheduled demo, not left running for self-serve installs
